text: He, when Themistocles once was saying that he thought the highest virtue of a general was to understand and foreknow the measures the enemy would take, replied, "This, indeed, Themistocles, is simply necessary, but the excellent thing in a general is to keep his hands from taking money."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Aristides
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
